text: Real-time iPhone touch. Duo simulator support. Smoother wireless mirroring.
iPhone 实时触控、Duo 模拟器支持，以及更稳定的无线镜像。
Redesigned. Light and dark. Faster iPhone control.
全新界面，支持浅色与深色，iPhone 控制更快。
连接一次，查看、操作、标注。
Open MCP Automation settings and click Connect Codex. Select StupidMirror in a new chat to open the embedded phone panel.
在 MCP 自动化设置中点击「连接 Codex」，新建聊天并选中 StupidMirror，即可打开内嵌手机面板。
Local WebRTC carries the phone video into Codex. Switch devices, pause, or resume without a separate mirror window.
通过本机 WebRTC 在 Codex 中查看手机画面；切换设备、暂停或继续，无需另开镜像窗口。
You and your AI can operate
你和 AI 都能操作
Enable manual control to tap and drag. AI observations keep images by default, with compact text and targeted controls.
开启操作模式即可点击和拖动；AI 观察默认保留图片，搭配精简文字和目标操作工具。
Freeze a frame, move and resize numbered regions, then send the marked image and your note with Command-Enter. The composer stays below the picture.
冻结画面，移动或缩放编号框，按 ⌘＋回车发送标注截图和说明。输入栏位于画面下方，不遮挡画面。
查看 Codex 使用指南
Video stays local. Screenshots requested by your AI and annotations you send follow your AI client’s data settings. Host support is required for image messages.
视频在本机传输；AI 请求的截图和你发送的标注受 AI 客户端的数据设置约束。图片消息需要宿主支持。
Put your iPhone on your Mac.
Mirror a real iPhone over USB or Wi-Fi. Then let local OCR, Accessibility, and MCP make it operable by you and your AI agent.
USB 或无线，把真实 iPhone 放到 Mac 上。再通过本地 OCR、访问树与 MCP，把它交给你和 AI 一起操作。
Mirroring, control, and automation no longer live in separate tools. Discovery, live video, independent windows, and AI actions all happen in one native Mac app.
镜像、控制和自动化不再是三套割裂的工具。设备发现、实时画面、独立窗口与 AI 操作，都在一个原生 macOS 应用里完成。
Open the camera. The mirror stays live.
开启相机，镜像仍然保持。
A mirror built to stay live
USB and Wi-Fi use the same signed iPhone screen agent and H.264/SRT video stream. Prepare the agent once over USB; video needs no Camera permission.
USB 和 Wi-Fi 使用同一套签名的 iPhone 屏幕组件与 H.264/SRT 视频流。先通过 USB 完成一次准备；画面本身不需要摄像头权限。
Connect, trust the Mac, and prepare the iPhone screen agent to start mirroring.
连接并信任 Mac，完成 iPhone 屏幕组件准备后即可镜像。
True device proportions for debugging, capture, and demos.
按真实设备比例展示，适合调试、录屏与演示。
Enter an SM- activation code to unlock multiple devices. No sign-in required.
输入 SM- 激活码即可解锁多设备功能，无需登录。
On iOS 27+ and supported simulators, system touch follows your press, drag and release. Native trackpad scrolling, pinch and rotation also stream when the system gesture service is available.
在 iOS 27 及以上版本和支持的模拟器上，系统触控实时跟随按下、拖动与抬起。系统手势服务可用时，原生窗口中的触控板滚动、缩放和旋转也会逐事件发送。
Prepare once over USB, then discover and mirror on the same local network.
一次 USB 准备，之后在同一局域网内主动发现并镜像。
macOS Vision OCR and iOS Accessibility replace visual guesswork with real targets.
macOS Vision OCR 与 iOS 访问树协同，减少视觉模型盲猜。
Tap, swipe, long-press, type, and clear on iPhone or Android 11+ from an agent workflow.
在 iPhone 或 Android 11+ 上执行点击、滑动、长按、输入与清空，直接进入 Agent 工作流。
Connect with USB debugging and use the same StupidMirror workspace for live mirroring, device audio, direct control, and MCP automation.
开启 USB 调试后，即可在同一个 StupidMirror 工作台中使用实时镜像、设备音频、直接控制和 MCP 自动化。
The built-in guide checks the device, your Apple development account, and the screen agent. After one USB setup, disconnect the cable and keep a full-resolution H.264 mirror over your LAN.
内置向导会检查设备、Apple 开发账号与画面代理。完成一次准备后，断开 USB，仍可通过局域网获得全分辨率 H.264 镜像。
首次通过 USB 准备一次
Mirroring and control stay separate. Viewing a screen never installs or starts the control path behind your back.
镜像与控制保持独立：只想查看画面时，不会擅自安装或启动控制流程。
StupidMirror includes an MCP server bound to localhost. It embeds no model and asks for no model API key — it hands the real device to the Codex or Claude Code setup you already use.
StupidMirror 内置只监听本机的 MCP Server。不内置模型，不要求额外填写模型 API Key，把真机能力直接交给你已在使用的 Codex 或 Claude Code。
The latest frame, local Vision OCR, and iOS Accessibility converge on the real target.
最新镜像帧、本地 Vision OCR 与 iOS 访问树共同定位真实目标。
Targets, taps, and swipe paths appear only on the Mac, ready for review or takeover.
目标框、点击位置和滑动轨迹只显示在 Mac 侧，方便随时确认与接管。
System Settings, the App Store, dense feeds, and custom canvases all yield semantic targets.
系统设置、App Store、内容流与自定义业务页面都能获得语义化目标。
Drag through the captures. Open any screen to inspect the recognized targets.
拖动浏览截图，点击任意画面可放大查看识别细节。
本地生活 / 密集信息
系统设置 / 原生控件
业务应用 / 自定义画布

OCR runs on demand on your Mac. Action overlays never go back to the iPhone or into the video stream. StupidMirror embeds no model, needs no model API key, and never uploads the screen to a model service on its own.
OCR 在 Mac 本地按需运行。操作标记不写回 iPhone，也不烧录进视频流。StupidMirror 自身不内置模型、不要求模型 API Key，更不会主动把屏幕上传给模型服务。
Debug real hardware, reproduce issues, and rerun flows without bouncing between iPhone and Mac.
真机调试、问题复现、流程回归，不再在 iPhone 与 Mac 之间反复切换。
Hand a real device to Codex or Claude Code through MCP for observable, verifiable workflows.
通过 MCP 把真机交给 Codex 或 Claude Code，执行可观察、可验证的操作链路。
Standalone mirrors fit recording, streaming, and demos; an account-bound SM- license unlocks parallel iPhone workflows.
独立镜像窗口适合录屏、直播与演示；绑定到账号的 SM- 许可可并行管理多台 iPhone。
macOS 15+ · Free for personal and noncommercial use · Commercial license required
macOS 15+ · 个人及非商业用途免费 · 商业使用需另行授权
Native iPhone mirroring & automation harness for macOS.
原生 macOS iPhone 镜像与自动化工具。
Does StupidMirror work without a cable?
When are Camera and Microphone permissions needed?
什么时候需要摄像头和麦克风权限？
Which AI agents can use it?
哪些 AI Agent 可以用？
Does the screen or my data go through a cloud service?
画面和数据会经过云端吗？
What do I need to run it?
Yes. Run Set Up This iPhone once over USB, then keep the iPhone and the Mac on the same network and mirror it over Wi-Fi. Wireless audio is not available.
不需要。先用 USB 完成一次「设置这台 iPhone」，之后让 iPhone 和 Mac 处在同一网络，就能通过 Wi-Fi 镜像。无线方式暂不支持声音。

iPhone video over USB or Wi-Fi needs neither permission. For a USB iPhone, choose Phone to keep sound on the device, or Mac to play it on this computer. Mac audio requires Camera and Microphone permissions for the USB audio source.
iPhone 的 USB 和 Wi-Fi 画面都不需要这两项权限。USB 连接时，可选「手机」让声音留在设备上，或选「Mac」在电脑播放。Mac 声音通道需要摄像头和麦克风权限，以访问 USB 音频源。
Yes. Android 11 or newer over ADB with USB debugging enabled. Video and device audio come from scrcpy, and control uses Appium with UiAutomator2.
支持。Android 11 及以上，开启 USB 调试后通过 ADB 连接。画面和声音来自 scrcpy，控制通过 Appium 与 UiAutomator2。
Codex through the bundled plugin, which shows the live phone screen inside the chat, and Claude Code or other MCP clients through the local MCP server. StupidMirror needs no model API key.
Codex 可以通过内置插件使用，聊天里能直接看到手机实时画面；Claude Code 和其他 MCP 客户端通过本机 MCP Server 接入。StupidMirror 本身不需要模型 API Key。
No. The Codex panel streams over encrypted local WebRTC without a cloud relay, the MCP server listens on this Mac only, and text recognition runs locally with Apple Vision.
不会。Codex 面板通过加密的本地 WebRTC 传输画面，没有云端中转；MCP Server 只监听本机；文字识别用 Apple Vision 在本地完成。

One device can be mirrored and controlled without signing in. An SM- activation code unlocks several devices at once. The source is available under PolyForm Noncommercial, and commercial use needs separate authorization.
单台设备无需登录即可镜像和控制。SM- 激活码可以解锁多台设备同时使用。源码以 PolyForm Noncommercial 许可公开，商业使用需要另行授权。

A Mac with macOS 15 or newer and Xcode for iPhone or iOS Simulator support. Real iPhones need trust and Developer Mode. Both USB and Wi-Fi iPhone video require a signed screen agent prepared through Set Up This iPhone over USB; accessibility automation and compatibility control use that agent too.
一台 macOS 15 或更新版本的 Mac；iPhone 和 iOS 模拟器支持需要 Xcode。iPhone 真机需信任这台 Mac 并开启开发者模式。USB 和 Wi-Fi 画面都需要先通过 USB「设置这台 iPhone」准备签名的屏幕组件，无障碍自动化与兼容控制也使用该组件。
